name: maheidem-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code plugins by maheidem - Windows-compatible versions and custom tools

plugins.name: obscura-browser
plugins.description: Stealth Obscura headless browser as a system-wide MCP (35 browser_* tools) that gets past Cloudflare. Bundles the Docker build (Obscura compiled --features stealth for real Chrome TLS/JA4), a supergateway HTTP gateway that injects server-level usage instructions, the /obscura:start command, and the driving-obscura skill.

plugins.name: interactive-cli
plugins.description: Drive any interactive, human-oriented CLI from Claude — spawn persistent sessions, send input, observe and stream output, wait for completion, and run end-to-end terminal tests. First skill: tmux-orchestrator (pure-CLI, no MCP dependency).

plugins.name: deep-research
plugins.description: Deep research agent with 5-phase workflow (SCOPE → SEARCH+CAPTURE → SYNTHESIZE → VALIDATE → HANDOFF), deterministic citation gate, dedup preflight, source-reliability rubric, and auto-maintained research index. Slash command /deep-research:research, agent-handoff protocol, validate-citations.sh + build-research-index.sh deterministic scripts, fixture test suite.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Standardized handoff documents for context preservation across agent / session boundaries. Ships the agent-handoff skill (write) and /handoff-resume command (read latest handoff after /clear).

plugins.name: pi-delegate
plugins.description: Delegate coding work to the locally-installed pi CLI (pi.dev's pi-coding-agent) so it runs on a local model. One RPC engine, one MCP facade: a zero-dependency stdio MCP server (keep-alive conversations, mid-turn steering, elicitation) plus the /pi-delegate:delegate command for task sizing/decomposition.

plugins.name: orchestrator-mode
plugins.description: Per-project orchestrator mode (off/on/pi/wf): the main conversation agent goes read-only (deny-by-default allowlist) while subagents keep full access. 'on' delegates via Agent/Task or Workflow; 'wf' via the Workflow tool, with Agent/Task limited to the Explore scout; 'pi' allows no subagents and routes code changes through the pi-delegate MCP tools. Config is <project>/.orchestrator-mode.json (mode, allowed-models, main-allow) plus a user-wide $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/orchestrator-mode.json main-allow list; main-allow entries are exact tool names or trailing-* prefixes. With allowed-models set, every delegated Agent/Task, workflow agent() and explicit pi_task model must be on the list, forks are denied, and this applies to subagents too. Config files are protected from all agents; the main-thread /mode write goes through the normal permission prompt. Main-thread writes under .remember/ and the auto-memory dir stay allowed. Fails closed on internal errors. OFF by default.

plugins.name: shepherd
plugins.description: Start a recurring 10-minute shepherd loop over a goal: invokes the built-in loop skill with a shepherd-role prompt (watch, act, unblock, understand problems) so the goal keeps running unattended. Fixed 10-minute cadence, session-only (backed by the loop skill's CronCreate scheduling, auto-expires per that tool's behavior).
